title: Booking horizon & time rules

tier1Hours.label: Tier 1: bookings under 1 day – lead time in hours
tier1Hours.help: Default 48 h (2 days). Range 1 h – 30 days.

tier2Days.label: Tier 2: 1 day to under 1 week – lead time in days

tier3Months.label: Tier 3: 1 week to 1 month – lead time in months

minLeadMinutes.label: Minimum lead time in minutes
minLeadMinutes.help: Earliest start from now. Default 0. Range 0–48 h.

minDurationMinutes.label: Minimum duration in minutes
minDurationMinutes.help: Default 60. Range 15 min – 24 h, in 15-minute steps.

fairnessLimit.label: Fairness limit
fairnessLimit.help: Confirmed bookings not yet started per resident. Default 3, 0 = unlimited.

requestExpiryHours.label: Expiry of unanswered requests (hours)
requestExpiryHours.help: Requests expire at the earlier of booking start or X hours after receipt. Default 48.

existingUntouched: Changes only apply to new requests. Existing bookings and requests remain unchanged.
